'''October 2001 Allentown tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Encounter, Allentown, Pennsylvania on 6 October 2001. [[Kelly Krieble]] won it. It is known from Kelly Krieble's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3024">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-07-the-encounter-allentown-pa-10-6-01d3024/ the-encounter-allentown-pa-10-6-01], DeckTech (Kelly "dr_divot" Krieble, 7 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-07-the-encounter-allentown-pa-10-6-01d3024/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2001
* '''Site:''' The Encounter, Allentown, Pennsylvania
* '''Winner:''' [[Kelly Krieble]]
